title: Verify RepoPact proposal reliability on the ForgeWire proving ground

preflight.note: Recorded before work on actual Fabric incident reproduction and ForgeWire-scale validation began. The Core correction already present in this branch is not represented as work performed under this follow-up item.

acceptance_criteria.text: Reproduce the reported Fabric work.propose timeout using the original repository, governance data, invocation trace, and host telemetry; record versions, environment, command, phase timings, affected records, root cause, and linked evidence. If those inputs remain unavailable, record the exact missing artifacts and leave this criterion pending.

Benchmark at least ten proposal runs on representative small, medium, and actual ForgeWire-scale repositories after separating cold read-only warm-up. Record p50, p95, worst case, phase timings, peak working set, records examined, hardware, and workload. Demonstrate p95 below 5,000 ms on the actual ForgeWire-scale fixture; keep this criterion pending if the fixture is unavailable or the target is not met.

Run adversarial acceptance coverage against the ForgeWire proving ground: stale dashboards and unrelated expired reviews remain non-blocking; authorization violations, broken authoritative references, and dependency cycles block; unknown-outcome retries and parallel proposals do not duplicate work; engine identity mismatch remains fail-closed; canonical full validation remains available and authoritative. Link executable results and the repository state used.
